statement: One clause is open per hashlock in an Account: a second lock on a hashlock that is already open is refused with lock_exists (naming the slot that holds it), whichever slot or side it names; the slot id stays the address of a clause, and a hashlock opens again once its clause is resolved, cancelled or expired. Multi-path payments are unaffected: each path runs over a different Account. The Arrival cell holds only that at most one clause is open per hashlock and a second lock is refused (spec/money/ledger.scm, bug duplicate-hashlock); that the refusal names the open slot and that a hashlock opens again are owed on the Arrival page. The Quint cell holds the lock_exists refusal only; it does not name the slot that holds the hashlock and has no test of the hashlock opening again.
